question: How many members are nominated by the President of India for the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to **Article 80** of the **Constitution of India**, the **President of India** has the authority to nominate **12 members** to the **Rajya Sabha**, which is the **Upper House** of the **Parliament**.
 
• These nominations are intended to provide a platform for distinguished individuals who have excelled in specific fields but may not necessarily enter the legislative process through **direct or indirect elections**.
 
• The **four functional categories** or fields from which these members are chosen are **Literature**, **Science**, **Art**, and **Social Service**.
 
• The total strength of the **Rajya Sabha** is limited to **250 members** by the Constitution, comprising **238 representatives** from the **States and Union Territories** and **12 members** nominated by the **President**.
